source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

carry.quote: Saturation Charge slows fleeing heroes; once they're low, Weald's missiles finish them through walls. Bonus attack speed, which also feeds Ballistic Calibration, adds more missiles.
carry.issue: overclaim: Weald missiles are small true-damage chip, they do not reliably finish a hero
carry.rewrite: Saturation Charge slows fleeing heroes; once they're low, Weald's missiles chip them through walls. Bonus attack speed, which also feeds Ballistic Calibration, adds more missiles.

support.quote: Saturation Charge slows low-health heroes, and Weald's missiles chase them through walls. Poke them low, then let it finish the escape.
support.issue: unclear "let it finish the escape" reads as helping them escape; overclaims a finish
support.rewrite: Poke heroes low, then slow them with Saturation Charge; Weald's missiles chase them through walls and add damage as they try to escape.

midlane.quote: Piercing Shot reaches through terrain and Weald's missiles go through walls, so low enemies escaping mid still get finished. Attack speed adds more missiles.
midlane.issue: overclaim: Weald missiles are small true-damage chip, they do not reliably finish a hero
midlane.rewrite: Piercing Shot reaches through terrain and Weald's missiles go through walls, so low enemies escaping mid still take damage. Bonus attack speed adds more missiles.

carry.quote: Narcosis holds a hero in place; once they're low, Weald's missiles finish them through walls. Cascade's attack speed adds more missiles.
carry.issue: overclaim: Weald missiles are small true-damage chip, they do not reliably finish a hero
carry.rewrite: Narcosis holds a hero in place; once they're low, Weald's missiles chip them through walls. Cascade's attack speed adds more missiles.

offlane.quote: Heresy and Wrath Unleashed attack speed add more missiles to finish low heroes through walls. Wind-Rider rewards diving in with Ascend.
offlane.issue: overclaim: Weald missiles are small true-damage chip, they do not reliably finish a hero
offlane.rewrite: Heresy and Wrath Unleashed attack speed add more Weald missiles, which chase low heroes through walls. Wind-Rider rewards diving in with Ascend.

midlane.quote: Rushing Beat dashes chase low heroes, and Weald's missiles finish them through walls. Wind-Rider adds attack speed after each Rushing Beat dash.
midlane.issue: overclaim: Weald missiles are small true-damage chip, they do not reliably finish a hero
midlane.rewrite: Rushing Beat dashes chase low heroes, and Weald's missiles follow them through walls. Wind-Rider adds attack speed after each Rushing Beat dash.

midlane.quote: Takedowns from map-wide Infinite Obliteration beams build Fearless power without putting Argus in danger; you get squishier, so poke from behind and avoid dying to keep stacks.
midlane.issue: misleading: Synaptic Obliterator is a long channel, so takedowns from it are not risk-free
midlane.rewrite: Infinite Obliteration beams let you join takedowns from far away to build Fearless, but you get squishier; channel Synaptic Obliterator from safety and avoid dying to keep stacks.

offlane.quote: Fearless stacks from takedowns boost every Synaptic Obliterator beam, but you lose health and stacks on death; poke with Particle Shredder from range instead of brawling the offlaner.
offlane.issue: misdescribes Satariel: the max health cut applies while stacked, only the stacks are lost on death
offlane.rewrite: Fearless stacks from takedowns boost every Synaptic Obliterator beam but lower your max health, and dying loses them; poke with Particle Shredder from range instead of brawling.

carry.quote: Farming waves with Obliterate ramps the bonus damage, and Bone Collector adds crit chance that pairs with Fate's guaranteed final-round crit and Bounty Hunter's crit scaling.
carry.issue: unsupported: extra crit chance does nothing for a round that always crits
carry.rewrite: Farming waves with Obliterate ramps the bonus damage; Bone Collector's crit chance makes more Fate shots crit and raises Bounty Hunter's power bonus.

offlane.quote: When Hellfire Rounds or Obliterate drop a hero low, Weald's missiles chase them through walls to finish; Forage adds gold and XP from lane farm.
offlane.issue: overclaim: Weald missiles are small true-damage chip, they do not reliably finish a hero
offlane.rewrite: When Hellfire Rounds or Obliterate drop a hero low, Weald's missiles chase them through walls for extra damage; Forage adds gold and XP from lane farm.

carry.quote: Throwing Molotov on cooldown stacks mana regen, earns gold from hero damage and grows Hold This!; Runic Focus adds magic power while your mana stays high.
carry.issue: Hold This! only grows when the Molotov explosion hits a hero, not on every throw
carry.rewrite: Landing Molotov on heroes stacks mana regen, earns gold from hero damage and grows Hold This!; Runic Focus adds magic power while your mana stays high.

carry.quote: LUNARI 4.0's quick attacks on one hero reach Vermis's max-health bonus fast; Melting Point helps shred armor-stacked frontliners late.
carry.issue: Melting Point adds damage against high-armor targets; it does not shred armor
carry.rewrite: LUNARI 4.0's quick attacks on one hero reach Vermis's max-health bonus fast; Melting Point adds damage against heavily armored frontliners late.

midlane.quote: Vortex Grenade pokes enemies low, then Weald's missiles finish them through walls; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after every Rocket Dash, which Grenadier also turns into a grenade charge.
midlane.issue: overclaim: Weald missiles are small true-damage chip, they do not reliably finish a hero
midlane.rewrite: Vortex Grenade pokes enemies low, then Weald's missiles chase them through walls; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after every Rocket Dash, which Grenadier also turns into a grenade charge.

support.quote: Your LUNARI 4.0 shots mark the enemy laner, winning lane trades; Savage Strikes adds healing on hit and Ferocity ramps attack speed in long fights.
support.issue: overclaim: the mark does not by itself win lane trades
support.rewrite: LUNARI 4.0 shots mark the enemy laner so they hit you softer and take more from you; Savage Strikes heals on hit and Ferocity ramps attack speed in long fights.

support.quote: Grenadier's extra Vortex Grenade charges help poke enemies low, then Weald's missiles finish them through walls; Taproot heals you from basic attacks.
support.issue: overclaim: Weald missiles are small true-damage chip, they do not reliably finish a hero
support.rewrite: Grenadier's extra Vortex Grenade charges help poke enemies low, then Weald's missiles chase them through walls; Taproot heals you from basic attacks.

offlane.quote: Vortex Grenade and Vaporize poke the offlaner low, then Weald's missiles finish through walls; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after each Rocket Dash.
offlane.issue: overclaim: Weald missiles are small true-damage chip, they do not reliably finish a hero; "finish through walls" is missing its object
offlane.rewrite: Vortex Grenade and Vaporize poke the offlaner low, then Weald's missiles chase them through walls; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after each Rocket Dash.

jungle.quote: Dryad's Boon cuts Smash 'n Grab and Stampede cooldowns as you attack, and Weald's missiles finish heroes fleeing your gank.
jungle.issue: overclaim: Weald missiles are small true-damage chip, they do not reliably finish a hero
jungle.rewrite: Dryad's Boon cuts Smash 'n Grab and Stampede cooldowns as you attack, and Weald's missiles chase heroes fleeing your gank through walls.

carry.quote: Weald's missiles finish heroes that Stampede and Double Pain leave low; Forage adds gold and XP from farm to help a melee carry keep up.
carry.issue: overclaim: Weald missiles are small true-damage chip, they do not reliably finish a hero
carry.rewrite: Weald's missiles chase heroes that Stampede and Double Pain leave low; Forage adds gold and XP from farm to help a melee carry keep up.

midlane.quote: Marking the mid laner with basic attacks wins extended trades; Savage Strikes heals per hit and Ferocity ramps attack speed during Warlord's Challenge.
midlane.issue: overclaim: the mark does not by itself win extended trades
midlane.rewrite: Marking the mid laner with basic attacks tilts extended trades your way; Savage Strikes heals per hit and Ferocity ramps attack speed during Warlord's Challenge.

midlane.quote: Heals from damage dealt, more as you drop low, adding to Lust For Blood; Leech cuts the mid laner's health regen to win the lane.
midlane.issue: overclaim: Leech cutting base regen does not win the lane
midlane.rewrite: Heals from damage dealt, more as you drop low, adding to Lust For Blood; Leech cuts the mid laner's base health regen so your poke sticks.

carry.quote: When Assault Mode shots drop a hero low, Weald's missiles finish them through walls; Taproot heals you from basic attacks.
carry.issue: overclaim: Weald missiles are small true-damage chip, they do not reliably finish a hero
carry.rewrite: When Assault Mode shots drop a hero low, Weald's missiles chase them through walls; Taproot heals you from basic attacks.

jungle.quote: Raises the stats from your items, boosting the attack speed and on-hit effects Chrono Swipe applies; Tri-Core adds bonus damage on every hit.
jungle.issue: Demiurge does not raise attack speed through Chrono Swipe; the dash only applies on-hit effects
jungle.rewrite: Raises the stats from your items and item effect damage, so on-hit items hit harder through Chrono Swipe's two swipes; Tri-Core adds bonus damage on every hit.

support.quote: Fragrance boosts true damage up close, which fits Imperial Lash, Royal Flourish and Iron Rose; Early Bloom grabs an extra level later in the game.
support.issue: Royal Flourish deals physical damage, not true damage, so Fragrance's true-damage bonus does not apply to it
support.rewrite: Fragrance boosts true damage on nearby heroes, which fits Imperial Lash, Acacia and Iron Rose's vine; Early Bloom grabs an extra level later in the game.

offlane.quote: Fragrance adds true damage up close, boosting Acacia, Iron Rose and Royal Flourish; Early Bloom gives an extra level later on.
offlane.issue: Royal Flourish deals physical damage, so Fragrance's true-damage bonus does not boost it; Fragrance increases, not adds, true damage
offlane.rewrite: Fragrance boosts true damage on nearby heroes, fitting Acacia and Iron Rose's vine; Early Bloom gives an extra level later on.

jungle.quote: Bonus armor helps you survive after Imperial Lash dashes in; Frost Snap adds damage while enemies are rooted or slowed by Seeds of Dominion's Thornbush.
jungle.issue: the Seeds of Dominion Thornbush only slows; the root comes from Imperial Lash
jungle.rewrite: Bonus armor helps you survive after Imperial Lash dashes in; Frost Snap adds damage while enemies are rooted by Imperial Lash or slowed by the Seeds of Dominion Thornbush.

offlane.quote: Takedowns stack power and attack speed that feed Combo Crunch, but shrink your health. Lean on Re-Crunch healing and avoid deaths, which wipe the stacks.
offlane.issue: Satariel's attack speed does not feed Combo Crunch; Combo Crunch stacks from Cross Crunch damage
offlane.rewrite: Takedowns stack power and attack speed on top of Combo Crunch, but shrink your health. Lean on Re-Crunch healing and avoid deaths, which wipe the stacks.

jungle.quote: Takedowns stack attack speed that powers Unleash flurries, but your health shrinks. Use Invigorate to cleanse and escape, since dying wipes the stacks.
jungle.issue: Unleash already grants maximum attack speed, so Satariel's attack speed does not power it
jungle.rewrite: Takedowns stack power and attack speed for Rage & Spirit attacks, but your health shrinks. Use Invigorate to cleanse and escape, since dying wipes the stacks.

offlane.quote: Rage & Spirit attacks mark your lane opponent, so long trades favor you. Ferocity's growing attack speed suits Lane Lurker's extended brawls.
offlane.issue: Lane Lurker grants Rage from minions; it does not create extended brawls
offlane.rewrite: Rage & Spirit attacks mark your lane opponent, so long trades favor you. Ferocity's growing attack speed rewards staying in extended brawls.

midlane.quote: Rage & Spirit attacks mark your lane opponent, so long trades favor you. Ferocity's growing attack speed suits Lane Lurker's extended brawls.
midlane.issue: Lane Lurker grants Rage from minions; it does not create extended brawls
midlane.rewrite: Rage & Spirit attacks mark your lane opponent, so long trades favor you. Ferocity's growing attack speed rewards staying in extended brawls.

carry.quote: Bigger item stats boost both Refibrillator's attack and its magic burn. Bio-Mechanical Fusion turns magic power into physical power for hybrid builds.
carry.issue: Bio-Mechanical Fusion adds physical power per magical power; it does not convert it
carry.rewrite: Bigger item stats boost both Refibrillator's attack and its magic burn. Bio-Mechanical Fusion adds physical power from your magical power for hybrid builds.

midlane.quote: Gideon's kit has no heal or shield, so Exarch only triggers from items or allies; when it does, Portal Blast attacks hit faster and harder.
midlane.issue: wrong: Fervour (listed minor) heals you and allies on Portal Blast hits, which triggers Exarch; allies' heals do not trigger your Exarch
midlane.rewrite: Fervour makes Portal Blast hits on heroes heal you and nearby allies, which triggers Exarch's attack speed and bonus magic damage, so attack after Cosmic Rift.

jungle.quote: Skullsplitter and Ruthless Assault stack Rust fast in ganks, and Peal makes Unstoppable Force apply full Rust, so open teamfights with your ultimate and dive in.
jungle.issue: Peal does not make Unstoppable Force apply Rust; after the ultimate is cast, your attacks and abilities apply full Rust
jungle.rewrite: Skullsplitter and Ruthless Assault stack Rust fast in ganks; after you cast Unstoppable Force, Peal makes your hits apply full Rust, so open teamfights with your ultimate.

offlane.quote: Doom grows while you keep damaging heroes, so chain Static Trap roots into sustained The Enforcer fire; Terror helps you trade under towers.
offlane.issue: "trade under towers" can read as safe to fight under enemy towers; Terror only cuts tower damage taken
offlane.rewrite: Doom grows while you keep damaging heroes, so chain Static Trap roots into sustained The Enforcer fire; Terror cuts minion and tower damage, easing long lanes.

jungle.quote: Xyris grows with camp clears; open ganks on healthy targets with Skull Crusher so Eviscerate boosts your Kingslayer damage.
jungle.issue: logic inverted: opening with Skull Crusher drops the target below the Eviscerate threshold before Kingslayer lands
jungle.rewrite: Xyris grows with camp clears; Eviscerate adds damage to targets above 80% health, so open ganks with Kingslayer on a full-health target.

jungle.quote: Vigil attacks mark your target for Thraex; Alpha's Court rewards solo ganks, so dive with Skull Crusher when the enemy laner is isolated.
jungle.issue: Alpha's Court needs no allied hero nearby, which most ganks have; "solo ganks" is misleading
jungle.rewrite: Vigil attacks mark your target for Thraex, cutting their damage to you; Alpha's Court adds damage only with no ally nearby, so it suits solo Skull Crusher invades.

midlane.quote: Morigesh scales into a late burst threat: farm safely with Hive, use Swarm to escape trouble, and let Lotus stacks grow.
midlane.issue: "late burst threat" is an unsupported claim; line never says what Lotus grants
midlane.rewrite: Lotus adds a random small bonus every 2 minutes and each takedown, so poke safely with Hive, use Swarm to escape trouble, and let the bonuses add up.

carry.quote: Hive and Mark poke turns hero damage into gold and keeps mana flowing, so you can throw Hive at a ranged distance all lane without running dry.
carry.issue: overclaim: Aion's small stacking mana regen does not let you poke all lane "without running dry"
carry.rewrite: Hive and Mark poke on heroes earns Aion gold, and each cast adds a little mana regen, so you can keep throwing Hive longer in lane.

offlane.quote: Nightmare Extractor means more Extract swings, and every swing or Contagion tick on a hero stacks shred, letting you out-trade bruisers while soaking their armor.
offlane.issue: "soaking their armor" is unclear jargon for gaining part of the shredded armor
offlane.rewrite: Nightmare Extractor means more Extract swings, and every swing or Contagion tick on a hero stacks shred, letting you out-trade bruisers while gaining part of their armor.

midlane.quote: Bonus armor while healthy and a shield when low suit a Beguile brawler; Frost Snap adds damage on targets slowed by Abduct or Beguile channels.
midlane.issue: wrong vs SOURCE: Beguile's channel slows Mourn himself, not enemies, so it does not set up Frost Snap that way
midlane.rewrite: Bonus armor while healthy and a shield when low suit a Beguile brawler; Frost Snap adds damage on targets Abduct pulls and slows.

jungle.quote: Each takedown makes Rising Storm and Windburn hit harder, but dying loses the stacks; play it when Storm of Salvation healing keeps you alive through fights.
jungle.issue: Satariel raises power and attack speed generally, not Rising Storm/Windburn specifically; omits the max-health cost
jungle.rewrite: Each takedown raises your power and attack speed but lowers max health, and dying loses the stacks; Storm of Salvation healing helps you survive Windburn fights.

offlane.quote: The Rumbling slows you while active, so extra max health helps you survive spinning Rumble in lane; Voracity heals as you clear minions.
offlane.issue: misdescribes Rumble as "spinning"; it pounds the ground
offlane.rewrite: The Rumbling slows you while Rumble is active, so extra max health helps you survive repeated Rumble casts in lane; Voracity heals as you clear minions.

offlane.quote: The Rumbling means many Rumble casts, each weakening nearby enemies' damage; Convection then grants armor per stack, making you very hard to kill up close.
offlane.issue: overclaim: a few armor per Pilow stack does not make you "very hard to kill"
offlane.rewrite: The Rumbling means many Rumble casts, each weakening nearby enemies' damage; Convection grants armor per Pilow stack, making you sturdier up close.

support.quote: Maco Gift! heals and Maco Fly! shields both trigger it, giving your carry bonus attack speed and magical damage; Revelation shortens cooldowns with each cast.
support.issue: Maco Fly! shields Maco himself, so it cannot give your carry Exarch's bonus
support.rewrite: Maco Gift! heals give your carry bonus attack speed and magical damage, and Maco Fly! shields do the same for you; Revelation shortens cooldowns with each cast.

jungle.quote: Masterful Mimicry clones fight alongside you, and this boosts item stats behind every Ruyi Jingu Bang hit; Construct adds health and ability haste each level.
jungle.issue: "this" reads as Masterful Mimicry boosting item stats; the Eternal is never named
jungle.rewrite: Demiurge boosts the item stats behind every Ruyi Jingu Bang hit while Masterful Mimicry clones fight beside you; Construct adds health and ability haste each level.

offlane.quote: Prosperous Path rewards kills, and each takedown here also stacks power behind Ruyi Jingu Bang; dying loses everything, so play it ahead.
offlane.issue: "dying loses everything" overstates it: only Fearless stacks are lost; omits the max-health cost
offlane.rewrite: Prosperous Path rewards kills, and each takedown stacks power behind Ruyi Jingu Bang but lowers max health; dying loses the stacks, so play it when ahead.

support.quote: Ruyi Jingu Bang and clone pressure from Masterful Mimicry help keep shred stacked, making the enemy duo easier for your carry to kill.
support.issue: unsupported: SOURCE gives no sign that clone hits apply Rust; Knell counts your own attacks and abilities
support.rewrite: Ruyi Jingu Bang hits and your abilities keep shred stacked on the enemy duo, making them easier for your carry to kill while you gain armor.

jungle.quote: Shadow Walk ganks that end in takedowns roll extra bonuses; Masterpiece stacks damage and speed per kill, helping chain Guillotine resets.
jungle.issue: invents a mechanic: Guillotine has no reset in the KIT
jungle.rewrite: Shadow Walk ganks that end in takedowns roll extra Lotus bonuses; Masterpiece stacks damage and speed per kill, helping you chase the next target with Guillotine.

jungle.quote: Each takedown from Shadow Walk ganks stacks more power, but you lose it on death; only pick it if you can avoid feeding.
jungle.issue: "feeding" is jargon a new player may not know
jungle.rewrite: Each takedown from Shadow Walk ganks adds power but lowers max health, and death removes the stacks, so pick it only if you can avoid dying.
